name: District of Columbia
feeText: D.C. Superior Court Family Court initial filing fees: filing complaint or petition $80.00; filing intervening petition $80.00; filing counterclaim $20.00. No fee is listed for an answer.

otherFees.what: Motion to reinstate under SCR-Dom. Rel. 41

waiver.name: Fee Waiver Application - Application to Waive "Prepayment of" Costs

residency.text: One spouse must have been a bona fide resident of D.C. for at least 6 months before filing; same-sex couples married in D.C. may divorce there without residency if their home jurisdiction will not hear the case (D.C. Code § 16-902(a), (b)).

waitingPeriod.text: No waiting period and no required period of separation: a divorce may be granted when one or both parties assert that they no longer wish to remain married (D.C. Code § 16-904(a), current text, last amended by D.C. Law 25-311 of March 21, 2025).

simplified.text: The Family Court provides a Joint Request for Uncontested Divorce form and a Consent Answer to Complaint for Divorce; there is no separate summary dissolution statute.

parentingClass.text: No statutory parenting-class requirement found in D.C. Code ch. 16-9 or on the Family Court divorce page.

uncertain: Response fee: no answer fee listed (counterclaim $20); set to null.
Waiting period: the court's divorce page (updated 02/11/2026) states there is no required separation period; no statutory waiting period after filing was found.
